changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Use the same developer-visible states for both sides of the feedback export expiry trigger.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE FUNCTION public.account_export_feedback_state_visible(state character varying) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE STRICT SECURITY INVOKER AS $$ SELECT state IN ('READY', 'DELIVERED', 'UNCONFIRMED', 'FAILED') $$;
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_feedback_changed_exports AFTER UPDATE OF state, body, destination, delivered_at, person_account_id ON public.feedback FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.person_account_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND public.account_export_feedback_state_visible(OLD.state) AND (NOT public.account_export_feedback_state_visible(NEW.state) OR (OLD.body, OLD.destination, OLD.delivered_at, OLD.person_account_id) IS DISTINCT FROM (NEW.body, NEW.destination, NEW.delivered_at, NEW.person_account_id))) EXECUTE FUNCTION public.account_export_feedback_changed();

rollback.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_feedback_changed_exports AFTER UPDATE OF state, body, destination, delivered_at, person_account_id ON public.feedback FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.person_account_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND OLD.state IN ('READY', 'DELIVERED', 'UNCONFIRMED', 'FAILED') AND (NEW.state NOT IN ('READY', 'DELIVERED', 'UNCONFIRMED', 'FAILED') OR (OLD.body, OLD.destination, OLD.delivered_at, OLD.person_account_id) IS DISTINCT FROM (NEW.body, NEW.destination, NEW.delivered_at, NEW.person_account_id))) EXECUTE FUNCTION public.account_export_feedback_changed();
DROP FUNCTION public.account_export_feedback_state_visible(character varying);
